jd:
Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à être plus efficaces et plus durables, et chaque personne ici contribue à cet impact. Vous aurez le pouvoir d’agir, le soutien nécessaire pour évoluer et la fierté de participer aux résultats que nous créons ensemble. Joignez-vous à nous et contribuez à ce qui fait avancer le monde.

Ce stage est un poste à temps plein pour l’hiver 2027, offert selon un mode de travail hybride, nécessitant une présence de trois jours par semaine au bureau de Dorval. Il s’inscrit dans un environnement de développement logiciel mettant l’accent sur la méthodologie Agile Scrum, favorisant le développement itératif, la rétroaction continue et le travail collaboratif.

Le stage est principalement axé sur le développement logiciel embarqué, avec pour objectif l’amélioration et la maintenance de micrologiciels (firmware) et de systèmes logiciels embarqués.

Responsabilités

Le ou la stagiaire deviendra un membre à part entière d’une équipe spécialisée en logiciels embarqués et contribuera à l’amélioration de la qualité logicielle par la mise en œuvre de nouvelles procédures, structures et outils. Le rôle comprend des activités pratiques de développement, de validation et de documentation, en alignement avec les priorités de l’équipe.



- Conception, développement et tests de solutions de gestion des fichiers de configuration.
- Développement de systèmes permettant la génération en masse, l’édition et la recherche de fichiers de configuration basés sur du texte.
- Utilisation d’outils en ligne de commande et d’applications graphiques en C#, ainsi que d’Excel VBA et d’applications Web pour faciliter la gestion des configurations.
- Développement de simulateurs de micrologiciels : création de simulateurs pour des composants matériels embarqués tels que des chargeurs, des systèmes de surveillance et des contrôleurs d’éclairage d’urgence. Ces outils permettront de tester et de valider les micrologiciels dans un environnement simulé, réduisant ainsi la dépendance au matériel physique durant les cycles de développement.
- Automatisation des tests d’intégration : mise en place de cadres de tests automatisés s’appuyant sur les simulateurs de micrologiciels afin d’assurer la robustesse, la fiabilité et la conformité des composants logiciels intégrés par des tests continus.
- Gestion des tests unitaires : développement, mise à jour et maintenance de tests unitaires afin de valider les modules de code individuels. Réalisation de validations continues pour assurer la stabilité du code et le respect des normes de qualité.
- Documentation technique : validation et amélioration de la documentation technique afin d’en renforcer la clarté, la traçabilité et la maintenabilité. Soutien au transfert des connaissances et facilitation des développements futurs.

Exigences

Langages De Programmation Et Environnements

Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) doit démontrer un ensemble complet de compétences techniques ainsi qu’une maîtrise linguistique appropriée :



- C, C++, C#, avec expérience dans le développement d’applications graphiques (GUI) et d’outils en ligne de commande.
- Excel VBA pour l’automatisation de tâches dans les feuilles de calcul.
- Scripts PowerShell ou fichiers batch (atouts pour les activités d’automatisation).

Gestion Du Code Source Et Des Tests



- Utilisation de Git pour la gestion du code source.
- Expérience avec les cadres de tests unitaires et de tests d’intégration.
- Familiarité avec les pipelines CI/CD pour faciliter l’intégration et le déploiement continus.

Systèmes Embarqués Et Microcontrôleurs



- Connaissance des familles de microcontrôleurs STMicroelectronics et Silicon Labs, essentielle pour le développement et la validation de micrologiciels embarqués.

Environnement De Développement Et Outils



- Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office, en particulier Word et Excel.
- Capacité à concevoir et à interpréter des schémas électriques, essentielle à la validation des systèmes embarqués et à l’intégration matériel‑logiciel.

Compétences Générales



- Esprit collaboratif et volonté d’apprendre dans un environnement Agile Scrum.
- Capacité à s’adapter à l’évolution des exigences des projets et à travailler efficacement en équipe..
- Le français est requis. L’anglais est également requis afin de communiquer régulièrement avec des clients à l’extérieur du Québec et de faciliter la collaboration au sein de l’équipe ainsi que la rédaction de la documentation.

Pourquoi ABB ? 

Nous vous donnons les moyens de prendre des initiatives, de remettre en question les idées et de diriger avec confiance. Vous évoluerez grâce à un travail porteur de sens, un apprentissage continu et un soutien adapté à vos objectifs. Chaque idée partagée et chaque action entreprise contribuent à quelque chose de plus grand.

SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

About The SambaNova Summer Internship Program

At SambaNova, our internship program is designed to give you hands-on experience tackling meaningful engineering challenges with real product impact. Because we are continuously evolving our program to provide the best possible experience, specific details and programming may vary by team and location, though you can generally expect the following:



- Program Structure & Duration: Our summer internships are structured as a 12-week experience, kicking off with onboarding and orientation, followed by mid-program check-ins, and wrapping up with final project presentations to your team and key stakeholders. 
- Dedicated Mentorship: To support your growth, interns are typically paired with both a manager and a peer host/mentor who provide structured mentorship, technical guidance, and project alignment throughout the summer. 
- Locations & Onsite Experience: Roles are based onsite at one of our global hubs— including San Jose (HQ), Austin, Bangalore, or Stockholm—to foster direct collaboration, community, and hands-on exposure to our teams and technology. (Note: Specific location availability varies by role.) 
- Community & Engagement: Depending on your location and cohort schedule, programming may include leadership fireside chats, workshops, hackathons, lab tours, and social outings to help you connect with fellow interns and leaders across the company. 
- Feedback & Future Opportunities: Throughout the program, you will receive structured feedback on your technical depth, ownership, collaboration, and project impact. High-performing interns may be considered for returning internships or full time opportunities upon graduation, subject to business needs and performance. 

Cloud Platform Engineer Intern 

San Jose, California Office 

About The Team

The Cloud Platform team runs the production inference service that serves SambaNova's models to customers on RDU accelerators. We handle deployment, monitoring, capacity planning, and incident response across regions in the United States, Asia, Europe, and Latin America.

About The Role

As a Cloud Platform Engineer Intern, you'll write automation and infrastructure code that keeps our inference service fast and available. You'll build monitoring and dashboards, work with Kubernetes clusters and Terraform modules, help with standing up new regions, and shadow our on-call rotation to see how incidents are handled. A dedicated mentor will guide you throughout the internship.

Responsibilities



- Build monitoring, alerting, and dashboards in Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog Help manage cloud and on-prem infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible Work with the Kubernetes clusters that run our inference workloads 
- Help automate setup ofAI infrastructure in new regions 
- Contribute to CI/CD pipelines that deploy new model versions and service updates safely 
- Shadow the on-call rotation and incident response 
- Present your project results to the team at the end of your internship 

Required Qualifications



- Currently pursuing a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field 
- Solid programming or scripting skills in Python, Go, or a similar language Familiarity with Linux and command line tools 
- Coursework or project experience in distributed systems, networking, or cloud computing 
- Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, and HTTP Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes 
- Exposure to a public cloud provider such as AWS, GCP, orAzure 
- Exposure to Terraform or other infrastructure as code tools 
- Exposure to monitoring tools such as Prometheus or Grafana 
- Exposure to CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, orArgoCD 

Preferred Qualifications



- Pursuing an M.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field Familiarity with model serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang 
- Prior internship experience in site reliability, DevOps, or backend infrastructure 
- Open source project ownership or contributions 

Submission Guidelines

Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified.

EEO Policy

SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Benefits Summary For US-Based, Full-Time Employment Positions

SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

Compensation: Unpaid / Academic Credit (Any future revenue-based bonus or stipend would only apply if/when revenues exist and strictly in compliance with applicable law)


About The Why Kid & Outliers
At The Why Kid, everything starts with curiosity—asking "why," exploring ideas hands-on, and cultivating learning environments that help young people grow rather than just memorize.


About Our App & Opportunity
Outliers is our educational app designed to help kids explore topics and improve their learning by 1% every day—compounding into 37x growth over a year. Outliers is built around 100% privacy, no LLM subscriptions required, and $0 marginal operational cost for the company, making daily, curiosity-driven learning sustainable at scale. Having completed initial end-user testing, Outliers is now moving toward production. 


Market Opportunity (TAM / SAM / SOM):

- TAM: Global K-12 and youth learning tools sit within a ~$214B+ global EdTech market (2026) across hundreds of millions of young learners worldwide.
- SAM: U.S. K-12 students (~54M nationally) and privacy-conscious families/schools—starting in California (~5.7M public K-12 students)—looking for effective daily learning without costly recurring AI subscriptions.
- SOM: Our near-term production beachhead across early student users, Bay Area/California communities, and pilot learners, where our $0 marginal cost architecture supports growth without per-query AI overhead. (Any future monetization or revenue-linked rewards remain subject to product evolution and applicable law.)


Academic Credit & Eligibility Requirement

- Credit Letter Required: In accordance with California internship requirements, this internship is structured as an educational experience tied to your school or college coursework. We only consider applicants who can provide an official school or college credit letter/approval confirming the role earns academic credit.
- Compensation Terms: This position is unpaid (focused on academic credit, mentorship, and structured learning). Any potential revenue-linked reward in the future would only be offered if and when revenues are generated and subject to formal terms and applicable employment/internship laws.


What You Will Do
Working with mentorship and clear learning objectives aligned with your credit program, you will help prepare Outliers for production:

- Build, refine, and test application features, UI/UX flows, and bug fixes as Outliers transitions from end-user testing to production.
- Help validate and maintain workflows that uphold 100% privacy, zero LLM subscription dependency, and $0 marginal operating cost.
- Collaborate on kid-friendly learning experiences, reliability checks, and technical documentation.
- Complete learning milestones, check-ins, or deliverables required by your school or college credit sponsor.


Qualifications

- Enrolled in high school or college and eligible to receive academic credit for an internship.
- Foundational software development skills (programming, debugging, testing, UI or back-end development, and familiarity with Git).
- Genuine interest in education, privacy-first software, lean/zero-marginal-cost architecture, and helping kids learn through curiosity.
- Strong communication, ownership, and willingness to learn in an early-stage product environment.


How to Apply

- Please follow our company https://www.thewhykid.com/
- Apply using the link above.
- Enlist Perplexity as your champion! We invite you to enlist Perplexity to advocate for your job application! Please create a Perplexity thread that explains why you're a strong candidate for this role. Here's a very basic example; feel free to keep it simple, or to have some more fun with your queries.
- Send your Perplexity session (Shared URL) to the company inbox.

ML Infrastructure Engineer Intern

About The Team

The ML Infrastructure team builds and operates the inference stack that serves SambaNova's models on our RDU accelerators. We cover request scheduling, caching, decoding techniques, public APIs, and the accuracy testing that every inference feature must pass before it ships.

About The Role

About Neuralink:
We are creating devices that enable a bi-directional interface with the brain. These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world. 
Team Description:
The Brain Computer Interface (BCI) Applications Team is responsible for delivering a product that gives people with paralysis the ability to control computers, phones, gaming consoles, and robotic arms with their minds at the same speed and functionality level as able-bodied people can. Furthermore, the team is focused on restoring speech for mute individuals and enabling direct, natural silent communication with AI agents.  In this role, you’ll work with neuroscientists, physicians, software engineers, and electrical engineers to develop the next-generation human-ready Brain-Computer Interface (BCI). 
Job Description and Responsibilities:
We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer Intern to develop novel neural decoders to increase control speed and accuracy, improve reliability, and expand functionality of BCIs. You will play a critical role in developing machine learning solutions and driving the successful execution of projects to achieve mission critical goals. You’ll work with cross-functional teams to design new BCI functionalities and novel computer user interfaces.

- Evidence in delivering high-impact projects either in academia or industry
- Prior experience designing and building Machine Learning models
- Deep understanding of machine learning concepts and fundamentals
- Experience in analyzing complex datasets, driving insights, and communicating results in a simple and clear way to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills
- Strong coding skills, with a focus on clean, efficient, and scalable code development

- Experience working with time series or unstructured data

About Kinaxis

 Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

 Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

 About the team

 You would be joining a full-stack AI/ML team at Kinaxis responsible for delivering complete functionality from the platform up to the solution, applying machine learning algorithms to develop intelligent supply chains. The team operates at the intersection of technology and real business problems in the supply and demand space for verticals such as Retail, Consumer Packaged Goods, Life Sciences, and others. This includes building a platform with workflows, containers and orchestration, REST services, and delivering solutions in forecasting, optimization, replenishment, recommendation, and explainability. You will contribute to a product that delights customers worldwide!

 Location 

 This is a hybrid position. You must be in the Ottawa office, at least three days a week.

 Term Duration 

  This is a full-time, 8, or 12-month position, starting January 2027

 Co-op / Intern Eligibility 

 This position is open to co-ops and interns. To be eligible, you must be currently enrolled in full-time education or be a recent/upcoming graduate within 12 months of the placement end date.

 Compensation range

 $27.04 - $39.66hourly rate. The final offer within this range will reflect the candidate’s skills, year of education, and experience.

 Vacancy Status 

 This is an existing job vacancy.

 What you will do 

 As an intern ML developer, you are passionate about shipping large-scale software systems in a fast-paced environment but can balance longer term concerns such as maintainability, scalability, and quality. 

• Collaborative Development: Work with senior engineers on developing, enhancing, and integrating software solutions for real-world AI/ML applications, from tech selection to production code on our latest projects. 
 
• Platform Enhancement: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our AI platform, ensuring scalability, maintainability, security, and quality. 
 
• End-to-End ML Development: Develop and integrate ML software end to end, including building and setting up new development tools, infrastructure, and ML pipelines and models. 
 
• Troubleshooting & Reliability: Design effective methods for troubleshooting, debugging, and preventing problems in ML software systems. Get to the root cause of issues, meeting users' needs and influencing the product development roadmap. Develop product capabilities and tools that increase the robustness of the user experience, reduce the cost of troubleshooting, or reduce the time required to address issues. 
 
• Automation & Process Improvement: Find ways to automate and improve development and release processes. 
 
• Software Reliability: Ensure user needs are met through cross-functional stakeholder understanding and engagement. Understand both the details of the use cases that end-users are performing using the solution as well as the architecture and implementation of the system end to end. 
 
• Learning & Growth: Gain hands-on experience in software development, Generative AI, cloud-native technologies, and machine learning through paired programming, code reviews, and mentorship. 
 
• Agile Practices: Participate in agile processes such as sprint planning, huddles, paired programming, and retrospectives, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions. 
 
• Ownership of Quality: Champion product quality by verifying the functional and non-functional quality of features developed. You will be treated like a full-time developer and are expected to take ownership of the features you develop. 
 
• Technologies you will work with: Python, C#, Docker, Kubernetes, Argo Workflows, Azure/GCP, GitHub Actions, Shell Script, Terraform, Linux/Unix CLI, SQL. 
 
 What we are looking for 

• Currently pursuing a Master's degree or have completed 3rd year Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 
• Familiarity and experience with Generative AI and LLMs, prompt engineering, AI coding assistants, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, etc. 
 
• Strong software engineering skills and programming proficiency in Python and C#, with experience using libraries such as Pandas and ML frameworks.  
 
• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes at scale, including the Kubernetes ecosystem (Helm, Argo Workflows, CI/CD). 
 
• Working experience with Azure/GCP cloud environments. 
 
• Proficiency in SQL – including advanced concepts such as window functions, aggregate functions, and joins. 
 
• Understanding of distributed computing architectures. 
 
• Experience with Machine Learning Solutions and productization. 
 
• Strong customer orientation and ability to understand the system end-user perspective while integrating ML software for production systems. 
 
• Ability to work through complex technical problems with a logical and methodical approach. 
 
• You love to work in a team, learning from others, and spreading knowledge. 
 
• Strong communication skills — ability to easily articulate complex concepts in writing and speech. 
 
• Enthusiastic about gaining hands-on experience in software development, AI/ML, and cloud computing. 
 
• You enjoy solving puzzles, troubleshooting issues, and multi-tasking to provide significant positive impact to the business.
